name: French A1.1
description: In this module, students gain basic knowledge of French as a foreign language, enabling them to successfully manage basic everyday situations with minimal language skills, e.g introducing themselves and others; talking about free-time activities; asking for information and for directions; shopping. Grammar topics include: present tense of regular and irregular verbs; personal pronouns; definite, indefinite and partitive articles; questions; and adjective declension. Moreover, opportunities will be made available for students to more effectively organize the process of learning French as a foreign language and thus to improve their own learning abilities.
